crossRefs.note: “The Lord Yahweh says to Tyre: ‘Won’t the islands shake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan, when the…
At the sound of the cry of your pilots, the pasture lands will shake.
When the report comes to Egypt, they will be in anguish at the report of Tyre.
Pass through your land like the Nile, daughter of Tarshish. There is no restraint any more.

translations.web: Now the islands will tremble in the day of your fall. Yes, the islands that are in the sea will be dismayed at your departure.’
translations.bsb: Now the coastlands tremble on the day of your downfall; the islands in the sea are dismayed by your demise.”’
translations.kjv: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall; yea, the isles that are in the sea shall be troubled at thy departure.
translations.asv: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall; yea, the isles that are in the sea shall be dismayed at thy departure.
